name: Strømpriser i dag API
description:
Hourly spot prices for the five Norwegian price areas, with VAT and the state electricity support (strømstøtte) already worked out, plus hourly grid tariffs (nettleie) for every Norwegian grid company.

No key is required. An optional free key raises the hourly limit from 120 to 2000 requests. Field names are English; free-text notes are in Norwegian.

Prices: Nord Pool via ENTSO-E. Grid tariffs: Fri Nettleie (kraftsystemet/fri-nettleie), CC BY 4.0. Free to use with a link to strompriseridag.no.
